# pixi-reels

> pixi-reels 4.4.0 is a slot machine reel engine for PixiJS v8: a fluent builder, typed events, spin phases, speed modes, cascades, Hold & Win, big symbols and win spotlights. It ships reel-only primitives; win math, paytables, RNG and audio stay in the game.

Install with `npm install pixi-reels pixi.js gsap`. Every mechanic page opens on live demos whose source is the recipe module shown beside them, runnable as-is in the Studio.
Everything below, inlined with each recipe's source and every FAQ answer: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/llms-full.txt

- Site: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev
- Repo: https://github.com/schmooky/pixi-reels
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pixi-reels
- Studio: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/studio/

## Mechanics

- [Anticipation](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/anticipation/): Hold the last reels back when a bonus is one scatter away, so the player watches them land.
- [Big symbols and MultiWays](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/big-symbols/): Symbols that span several cells, and boards whose reels show different numbers of rows.
- [Cascades](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/cascade/): Winning symbols burst, the rest fall into the gaps and new ones drop in, until nothing else wins.
- [Paylines and overlays](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/cells-and-banners/): Find any cell on screen to draw paylines, badges and highlights over the board, or to make a cell tappable.
- [Spin feel](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/feel/): Tune how a spin starts and stops: the stagger between reels, a wind-up, the kick on landing.
- [Hold & Win](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/hold-and-win/): Coins stick where they land and the empty cells respin until the counter runs out or the board fills.
- [Infinity reels](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/infinity-reels/): The board gains reels on the right after the spin lands, as many as the result asks for.
- [Layers](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/layers/): Draw a symbol over its neighbours or outside the reel frame, and build your own board out of the same cells.
- [Reel windows](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/masks/): Show the reels through a rounded window, a card per reel or any shape you draw.
- [Nudge](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/nudge/): Push a reel that has already stopped up or down a few places to pull a symbol into view.
- [Sideways and upward reels](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/orientation-and-direction/): Reels that run sideways or upward, for banners and portrait layouts. The art stays upright.
- [Curved reels](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/reel-curvature/): Bend the strip onto a drum so the top and bottom cells lean away, like a physical machine.
- [Skip and slam](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/skip/): Decide what a tap does mid-spin: stop every reel, land them one by one, or let a tease finish.
- [Spinning art](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/spinning-art/): While a reel spins it shows a blurred still of each symbol, so heavy art costs nothing and reads as motion.
- [Split symbols](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/split-symbols/): A winning symbol breaks into two or more copies, and its reel makes room for them.
- [Starters](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/starters/): Small complete slots to copy as a starting point, one for each common layout.
- [Symbol classes](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/symbols/): Pick or write the class that draws a symbol, from sprites to Spine, and animate it when it wins.
- [Wilds and mystery symbols](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/mechanics/wilds-and-pins/): Wilds that stay, spread or walk between spins, and mystery symbols that all turn into the same one.

## Learn

- [Cheats & testing](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/learn/cheats-and-testing/): Force outcomes with cheats and run full spins in Node, so mechanic tests give the same result every run.
- [Debugging](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/learn/debugging/): Snapshot the reel state as JSON, render an ASCII grid, trace every event.
- [Getting started](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/learn/getting-started/): Install pixi-reels and get a 5x3 reel set spinning in a PixiJS v8 app.
- [Recipe previews](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/learn/recipe-previews/): How to give a recipe a card thumbnail and inline body images. Drop a file in public/; a missing one falls back to a generated placeholder.
- [Build your first cascade slot](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/learn/your-first-cascade/): A tutorial that builds a 6x5 cascade slot in about 80 lines of TypeScript, for readers new to pixi-reels.
- [Your first reelset](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/learn/your-first-reelset/): Build, spin, and react to a reel set from scratch.

## Reference

- [ReelSetBuilder](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/api-builder/): The fluent builder for ReelSet. Each method sets one part of the configuration, and build() checks it and returns the set.
- [Events](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/api-events/): The typed events on reelSet.events and reel.events, when each one fires, and what its payload holds.
- [Phases](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/api-phases/): START, SPIN, ANTICIPATION, STOP: the four lifecycle phases and how to extend them.
- [ReelSet](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/api-reelset/): The PIXI.Container that runs the reels. Build it with ReelSetBuilder, then call its methods to spin, set results and run cascades.
- [Glossary](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/glossary/): Definitions of slot vocabulary and of the names pixi-reels gives its parts.
- [Migrating to 1.0.0](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/migrating-to-1-0/): Mechanical changes to move from 0.x to 1.0.0. Every breaking change with a before and after.
- [Migrating to 2.0.0](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/migrating-to-2-0/): Every breaking change in 2.0.0, with a before and after. Rows became cells, above/below became start/end, and one codemod does most of it.
- [Migrating to 3.0.0](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/migrating-to-3-0/): Every breaking change in 3.0.0, with a before and after. Skip presses take a mode, phases take a skip context, the built-in beats are moves, and the…
- [Migrating to 4.0.0](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/migrating-to-4-0/): The visual debug tools moved to the pixi-reels/debug subpath and draw with pixi-silk; two imports change and two console helpers are gone. A Hold & Win board's…
- [Changelog](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/reference/changelog/): Per-release notes for the pixi-reels engine. Latest published version: v4.4.0.

## Architecture deep-dives

- [Anticipation](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/anticipation/): How a teasing reel slows, holds and creeps onto its symbols before it lands.
- [The builder](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/builder/): What build() validates and constructs, in order.
- [Cascade physics](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/cascade/): Why survivors without holes below them never move.
- [Classes](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/classes/): The ownership tree. Who owns what, who destroys what.
- [Curvature](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/curvature/): How a flat strip is projected onto a drum, in two modes.
- [Debug tooling](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/debug/): JSON snapshots for agents, the canvas overlay drawn with pixi-silk, and SpinMetrics timings.
- [Events](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/events/): What fires when, in what order, on which bus.
- [The frame pipeline](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/frame-pipeline/): How a result grid becomes the symbols that land, wrap by wrap.
- [Motion](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/motion/): How a column of symbols scrolls, wraps and stops exactly on the grid.
- [Overview](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/overview/): The main parts of pixi-reels and how they are wired together.
- [Pins, boards, Hold & Win](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/pins-and-boards/): Cell pins across spins, the BoardGrid, the Hold & Win state machine.
- [Skipping](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/skipping/): What a press does to reels that are still spinning, and how tease protection and reel groups limit it.
- [Speed profiles](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/speed-profiles/): The object that holds a spin's timing, such as stagger, speed and bounce, and how to tune it.
- [Spin lifecycle](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/spin-lifecycle/): What happens to one reel between spin() and its landing, phase by phase.
- [Symbols and pooling](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/symbols/): The ReelSymbol lifecycle, and how the registry, factory and pool supply symbols to a reel.
- [Testing model](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/testing/): Why a full spin runs in Node with no renderer.
- [A spin in milliseconds](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/timeline/): One ordinary spin, replayed with a stopwatch, from the button press to spin:complete.
- [Viewport and masks](https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/architecture/viewport-and-masks/): The five layers under and above the mask, and the strategies that draw the mask.
